references.text: Describes the recipe for the holy anointing oil to be used to anoint priests and sacred objects.
Aaron and his sons shall be anointed to serve as priests for the Lord.
The fulfillment of the command to anoint Aaron, where Moses pours the anointing oil over Aaron's head.
Refers to the high priest who has received the anointing oil poured completely over his head.
A poetic image of the precious oil running down over Aaron's head and beard.
Samuel anoints Saul by pouring oil over his head, a parallel to priestly anointing.
Samuel anoints David with oil, and the Spirit of the Lord comes upon him.
Christ is anointed with the oil of gladness above his brothers, fulfilling the Old Testament tradition of anointing.
A parallel between priestly and royal anointing as a sign of God's election.
Contrast between ritual consecration for service and prophetic anointing for burial.
Extension of the anointing ritual from the person to all the furnishings of the tabernacle.
The completion of the consecration ritual through the combination of blood and anointing oil.
